routing_decision.path: shot_routing.md non physical path: the offer visual spec replaces the product rows; hero plate, lifestyle, people and video minimums are not applicable to a Tier 1 procedural concept site whose brief bans photographic imagery
routing_decision.statement: Every asset is brand owned and produced in the sandbox from the offering spec and the art direction spec. No stock base was sourced, qualified or registered; no AI image tool was driven; Chrome was not used. The product image is the DOM rendered console frame; these PNGs are its OG and social stand ins only.

grade_recipe.decision: grade_and_unify.py NOT run: every raster is drawn directly in the six brand palette values (97 to 99 percent exact palette pixels, remainder anti aliasing); a LUT, grain or vignette would violate the art direction (no grain, no scanlines, no noise, no vignette)
